title: In-Person Appointments Scheduling Template: Slot Length, Booking Horizon and Lead Time
content:
Every In-Person Appointments visit type is scheduled on its own template. The template fixes how long the slot is, how far ahead the visit may be placed, how soon before its start it may still be booked, whether the patient can book it personally in the MyLinden portal, and whether it can be placed on the same calendar day.

## Template figures by visit type

| Visit type | Slot length (minutes) | Booking horizon (calendar days from the booking date) | Minimum lead from booking to start (hours) | MyLinden self-scheduling | Same-day booking |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Nurse Visit | 15 | 60 | 2 | Yes | Yes |
| Established Patient Office Visit | 20 | 120 | 2 | Yes | Yes |
| New Patient Office Visit | 40 | 120 | 24 | Yes | No |
| Annual Preventive Exam | 40 | 365 | 24 | Yes | No |
| Specialist Consultation | 40 | 180 | 24 | No | No |
| In-Office Procedure Visit | 60 | 180 | 72 | No | No |
| Advanced Imaging Appointment | 45 | 90 | 48 | No | No |

## What each figure means

- **Slot length** is the length of the scheduled slot for the visit type, in whole minutes; each visit occupies one slot of that length.
- **Booking horizon** is the furthest calendar day ahead, counted from the booking date, on which the visit type may be scheduled.
- **Minimum lead** is the least number of hours that must separate the moment of booking from the scheduled start.
- **MyLinden self-scheduling** records whether the patient may book the visit type directly in the MyLinden portal; where it reads No, the visit type is booked by phone or at the front desk.
- **Same-day booking** records whether the visit type may be booked for the same calendar day as the booking.

## Reading the template (hypothetical illustrations)

- *Hypothetical:* an Advanced Imaging Appointment booked on a Monday at 09:00 for Wednesday at 09:00 has a lead of 48 hours, which meets the 48-hour minimum; the same request for Wednesday at 08:30 has a lead of 47.5 hours and does not.
- *Hypothetical:* an Annual Preventive Exam may be placed as far as 365 calendar days after the booking date, while a Nurse Visit reaches only 60 days ahead.
- Only the Nurse Visit and the Established Patient Office Visit carry Yes for same-day booking; every other visit type reads No.
